list.title: Events
list.pick: Pick an event to edit its reply.

editor.enabledHelp: An event that is off stays in the list and says nothing.
editor.pickHelp: The bot picks one of these lines each time, in your channel's tone. Edit a line to start from its text.
editor.ownHelp: The bot posts this line in chat when the event happens.
editor.replaces: Saving makes this your only line: it replaces the default line. | Saving makes this your only line: it replaces the {count} default lines.
editor.speakHelp: The reply also plays as speech on your stream.
editor.resetDescription: The bot goes back to the platform default lines for this event.

resetLosesBinding.pipeline: The pipeline this event runs is unbound.
resetLosesBinding.command: The command this event runs is unbound.
resetLosesBinding.action: The action this event runs is unbound: {action}

test.title: Test: {event}
test.description: A sample event fires through this response. The line is sent to your chat and read aloud like a real event. Nothing is granted or counted.
test.chatNone: No chat line. The response says nothing in chat.
test.ttsNone: No speech. Nothing is read aloud.
test.ttsStep: A pipeline step read a line aloud.
test.alertsNone: No alerts sent to the overlay.
test.economy: This test runs {steps} for real. It can change the points of the person who runs the test.

warnings.no_overlay_source: Open your overlay in OBS or a browser to see the alert. No overlay is open, so the alert has nowhere to show.
warnings.response_disabled: This response is switched off, so nothing was presented. Turn on Enabled to use it.
warnings.no_pipeline: This response has no pipeline to run. Pick a pipeline, or switch to a simple reply.
